title: Signed patterns of patterns: signed laws survive native coarse-graining
claim: Signed three-bit laws (weights plus or minus one whose support is a knot) under native gadgets of their own copies (every hidden variable in exactly two distinct copies, three legs). Theorem 1: an exact signed fixed point, legs relabelled, multiplies any network's signed sum by its factor per copy and keeps its law at every level of its tower. Lemma 2: two copies sharing two variables contract to a multiple of the identity exactly when a flattening has orthogonal rows of equal norm; unsigned, only parity; every exact fixed point of the three-copy shape with a doubled edge contracts that edge to an invertible matrix (19,840 signed wires and 32 shears among 19,872 cases). Theorem 3 (exhaustive over native gadgets of three and five copies, every shape, placement and sign pattern): without signs only the two parity classes are rebuilt (GEOMETRY-LAW-20261029-001A); with signs 14 of the 16 classes are rebuilt and 12 have exact signed fixed points, 10 of them on the native triangle (Sierpinski gasket); the two Fibonacci fusion knots (no lone one, no lone zero) are never rebuilt and the symmetric atoms (or, nand) are rebuilt but never exact. Proposition 4: signed not-all-equal with -1 on 110 is exact on the native triangle with factor 3, and every signed not-all-equal-type law with positive Cayley hyperdeterminant is exact there (sufficient, not necessary). Proposition 5: under the shared-boundary (triangular-lattice) substitution, signed laws constant on rotation orbits of the seven cyclic knots (22 laws) are exact on the tetrahedron, octahedron and icosahedron only for parity.
failure_conditions: The unsigned baseline disagrees with GEOMETRY-LAW-20261029-001A (only parity rebuilt).
A reported exact signed fixed point whose leg function is not a nonzero multiple of a placement of the law.
A tower of an exact signed fixed point whose level-two or level-three law differs from the law.
foundation_claim_scope: Signed three-bit laws (weights in {-1,0,1} with a knot as support) under native gadgets of three and five copies, every shape and placement; supports read as allowed states under the interference reading (allowed when the signed witness sum is nonzero), beside the canonical existential reading; shared-boundary test on three closed surfaces for laws constant on rotation orbits.

validation.status: checked: 34 knots in 16 classes; shapes (2 at three copies, 9 at five); unsigned baseline equals GEOMETRY-LAW (only parity); exhaustive signed census over every shape, placement and sign pattern at three and five copies; 7,108 exact cases iterated to level 4; wires (unsigned only parity) and 19,872 doubled-edge contractions (all invertible); not-all-equal triangle table against the hyperdeterminant; 22 cyclic signed laws contracted exactly on three spheres and their subdivisions; controls fire (40 brute-force gadgets, the explicit not-all-equal triangle, one more sign breaks it, parity with weight 2 on 000 is not exact); three checker failures found and fixed during the work (recorded in the decision note); no human or external review
validation.novelty: Theorem 1 and Lemma 2 elementary; Theorem 3 and Propositions 4-5: no overlap found (candidate local delta)
